```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(vars)
library(tsDyn)

load_baseline_helpers <- function() {
  project_files <- c(
    "core_formatting.R",
    "yield_estimation/bl_single_curve.R",
    "yield_estimation/bl_feature_extract.R"
  )

  invisible(lapply(project_files, function(path) {
    sys.source(here::here(path), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }))
}

load_baseline_helpers()

raw_yields <- list(
  usa_r <- "usa-full.csv", 
  gbr_r <- "gbr-full.csv", 
  jpn_r <- "jpn-full.csv", 
  cad_r <- "cad-full.csv", 
  ger_r <- "ger-full.csv", 
  fra_r <- "fra-full.csv", 
  itl_r <- "itl-full.csv", 
  aus_r <- "aus-full.csv"
)
  
curve_files <- list(
  usa = "usa-bs.csv",
  gbr = "gbr-bs.csv",
  jpn = "jpn-bs.csv",
  cad = "cad-bs.csv",
  ger = "ger-bs.csv",
  fra = "fra-bs.csv",
  itl = "itl-bs-ib.csv",
  aus = "aus-bs-ib.csv"
)

curves = c("usa", "gbr", "jpn", "cad", "ger", "fra", "itl", "aus")

yields <- lapply(curve_files, function(x) {
  read.csv(here("reconstructed_data", x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

yields <- lapply(yields, function(x) {
 x %>% dplyr::filter(as.Date(time) >= as.Date("2010-01-01") & 
                       as.Date(time) <= as.Date("2020-12-31"))
})
```

raw_curves <- lapply(raw_yields, function(x) {
  read.csv(here("reconstructed_data", x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

raw_curves <- lapply(raw_curves, function(x) {
  x %>% dplyr::filter(as.Date(time) >= as.Date("2010-01-01") &

rebuild_counts <- setNames(lapply(raw_curves, function(x) colSums(!is.na(x))), curves)
rebuild_counts

```{r}
## curve summary statistics 
summarize_curve <- function(curve_name, curve_data) {
  tenor_cols <- setdiff(names(curve_data), "time")
  tenor_data <- lapply(curve_data[tenor_cols], as.numeric)

  curve_stats <- lapply(tenor_cols, function(tenor) {
    values <- tenor_data[[tenor]]

    data.frame(
      curve = curve_name,
      tenor = tenor,
      mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE), 
      min = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, curve_stats)
}

curve_summary_stats <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(yields), function(curve_name) {
    summarize_curve(curve_name, yields[[curve_name]])
  })
)

row.names(curve_summary_stats) <- NULL
curve_summary_stats
```

```{r}
## annual pairwise cointegration ranks from DNS fits
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)
cutoffs <- c(4, 8)
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.15, by = 0.005)
pairwise_curves <- setdiff(names(curve_files), c("itl", "aus"))
years <- 2010:2020
curve_pairs <- combn(pairwise_curves, 2, simplify = FALSE)

annual_pairwise_yields <- setNames(lapply(years, function(year) {
  lapply(yields[pairwise_curves], function(curve_df) {
    curve_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(format(as.Date(time), "%Y") == as.character(year))
  })
}), years)

annual_selected_lambdas <- purrr::imap(annual_pairwise_yields, function(year_yields, year_label) {
  setNames(lapply(pairwise_curves, function(curve_name) {
    lambda_grid_search(
      lambda_grid = lambdas,
      yields = year_yields[[curve_name]],
      mats = mats
    )
  }), pairwise_curves)
})

annual_dns_fits <- setNames(lapply(names(annual_pairwise_yields), function(year_label) {
  curve_fit_list <- setNames(lapply(pairwise_curves, function(curve_name) {
    bl_single_curve(
      lambda_select = annual_selected_lambdas[[year_label]][[curve_name]],
      yields = annual_pairwise_yields[[year_label]][[curve_name]],
      cutoffs = cutoffs,
      mats = mats
    )
  }), pairwise_curves)

  purrr::transpose(curve_fit_list)
}), names(annual_pairwise_yields))

annual_dns_betas <- purrr::imap(annual_dns_fits, function(fit_obj, year_label) {
  setNames(lapply(pairwise_curves, function(curve_name) {
    tibble::tibble(
      time = annual_pairwise_yields[[year_label]][[curve_name]]$time,
      L = fit_obj$betas[[curve_name]]$NSbetas[, 1],
      S = fit_obj$betas[[curve_name]]$NSbetas[, 2],
      C = fit_obj$betas[[curve_name]]$NSbetas[, 3]
    )
  }), pairwise_curves)
})

fit_pairwise_cointegration <- function(blsc_list, curve_pair,
                                       estim = "ML", type = "eigen", alpha = 0.1) {
  curve_1 <- curve_pair[[1]]
  curve_2 <- curve_pair[[2]]

  pairwise_var <- blmc_VAR(
    blsc_list = blsc_list,
    reference = curve_1,
    curves = c(curve_1, curve_2)
  )[[curve_2]]

  pairwise_ecm <- tryCatch(
    blmc_ECM(cc_betas = pairwise_var, estim = estim, type = type, alpha = alpha),
    error = function(e) {
      list(rank = NA_integer_, error = conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    curve_1 = curve_1,
    curve_2 = curve_2,
    cointegration_rank = pairwise_ecm$rank,
    error = if (!is.null(pairwise_ecm$error)) pairwise_ecm$error else NA_character_
  )
}

annual_pairwise_cointegration_ranks <- purrr::imap_dfr(annual_dns_fits, function(fit_obj, year_label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(curve_pairs, fit_pairwise_cointegration, blsc_list = fit_obj) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year_label), .before = 1)
})

annual_pairwise_cointegration_ranks

coint_avg <- annual_pairwise_cointegration_ranks %>%
  dplyr::select(-error) %>%  # explicitly drop the error column
  mutate(
    curve_a = pmin(curve_1, curve_2),
    curve_b = pmax(curve_1, curve_2)
  ) %>%
  group_by(curve_a, curve_b) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_cointegration_rank = mean(cointegration_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_obs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coint_avg %>% dplyr::arrange(avg_cointegration_rank)
```
